fullName.en: Guna Caves (Devil's Kitchen), Kodaikanal, Tamil Nadu

tagline.en: Kodaikanal's Devil's Kitchen: narrow crevices, deep unmapped pits and one famous rescue

summary.en: Guna Caves, first called Devil's Kitchen, are a set of cave passages and narrow crevices that lead down to deep pits, near Pillar Rocks on the Moir Point road outside Kodaikanal. Tamil Nadu Tourism says B. S. Ward recorded them in 1821. They took the name Guna after Kamal Haasan's 1991 Tamil film Gunaa was shot here. In 2006 Siju David climbed down and pulled his friend Subhash Chandran out alive, the only known survival after a fall into the caves. That rescue became the 2024 Malayalam film Manjummel Boys. Today you can walk through the pine forest and look in from fenced viewpoints, but the cave mouth is barred with iron grilles.

en: Moir Point road, near Pillar Rocks, Kodaikanal, Dindigul district, Tamil Nadu
never surveyed; the 2006 rescue hole is described as about 100 ft (30 m) deep
cave entry prohibited; view from fenced points (forest department area)
about 9 AM–5 PM (seasonal changes; check locally)

desc.en: The cleft in the rock where the passages begin. British records called the place Devil's Kitchen; Tamil Nadu Tourism links the name to the bat colonies that live in the warmth of the caves. In this model the mouth is a tall, narrow slot between boulders. The real opening's exact size isn't published, so its shape here is approximate.
desc.hi: दरारों के बीच की यही चट्टानी खुली जगह गुफा मार्ग की शुरुआत है। इस प्रवेश का सटीक आकार प्रकाशित नहीं है, इसलिए मॉडल में इसे अनुमानित रूप में दिखाया गया है।

desc.en: After repeated deaths the caves were closed from the early 2000s. Today the deep, narrow openings are barricaded and grilled with iron bars, and nobody is allowed inside. In 2006 a Tamil warning sign said 13 people had died there; the Manjummel group couldn't read Tamil and crossed the old fence.
desc.hi: सुरक्षा के लिए गहरी और संकरी गुफाओं को लोहे की सलाखों से बंद किया गया है। अंदर जाना मना है।

desc.en: Visitors look into the caves from a few safe, railed positions, reached by a forest path with steps made from wooden logs. The road reopened in 2024 after Manjummel Boys made the site famous again, and the forest department opens the area during the day (about 9 AM–5 PM, earlier in summer season).
desc.hi: लॉग से बनी सीढ़ियों वाले वन-पथ से पहुँचने वाले रेलिंगयुक्त सुरक्षित स्थानों से ही गुफाएँ देखें।

desc.en: The caves sit inside a mass of huge boulders and rock near the Pillar Rocks, at about 2,200 m in the Palani Hills. Rainwater runs through the cracks, so the rock inside stays wet and slippery. Rock shapes in this model are an artistic reconstruction, not a survey.
desc.hi: गुफाएँ पलानी पहाड़ियों में लगभग 2,200–2,230 मीटर की ऊँचाई पर बड़े शिलाखंडों के बीच हैं। मॉडल की चट्टानें कलात्मक पुनर्निर्माण हैं।

desc.en: The area is covered in shola trees and grass. Their gnarled, matted and twisted roots spread over the rocks and are the most photographed sight at Guna Caves today.
desc.hi: यहाँ शोल वृक्षों और घास के बीच उनकी उलझी हुई जड़ें चट्टानों पर फैली हैं।

desc.en: You reach the caves after a walk through pine forest from Moir Point. Pine Forest, Pillar Rocks and Moir Point are all forest-department spots on the same circuit. The tall pale trees in the model stand in for the mixed plantation trees around Kodaikanal and are illustrative.
desc.hi: मोयर पॉइंट से चीड़ के जंगल के रास्ते गुफाओं तक पहुँचा जाता है। मॉडल के पेड़ आसपास के मिश्रित वृक्षारोपण का सांकेतिक रूप हैं।

desc.en: Cracks between the boulders let thin beams of daylight into the upper cave, which is why the first chamber isn't totally dark. Deeper down there's little to no sunlight or fresh air. The exact positions of these openings aren't mapped; this one is illustrative.
desc.hi: चट्टानों की दरारों से ऊपरी गुफा में थोड़ी रोशनी आती है। गहरी जगहें अँधेरी रहती हैं; दरारों का स्थान अनुमानित है।

desc.en: The higher part of the cave, still reached by a little daylight. Scenes of Gunaa (1991), including the song 'Kanmani Anbodu Kadhalan', were filmed in the cave, and the site has been known as Guna Caves ever since. Parts of Shikkar (2010) and Manjummel Boys (2024) were also shot here. The chamber's size in the model is approximate.
desc.hi: ऊपरी हिस्से में थोड़ी प्राकृतिक रोशनी पहुँचती है। गुफा का यह आकार अनुमानित है।

desc.en: Dark, winding, narrow passages with no mapping of their routes lead from the upper cave towards the pits. They're wet and slippery, which is how most accidents here have happened.
desc.hi: अँधेरे, घुमावदार और नम संकरे रास्तों का मानचित्रण नहीं हुआ है।

desc.en: Some holes in the cave floor are as small as one foot by one foot. People have dropped stones in them and judged from the echo that they are several hundred feet deep, or even bottomless. Nobody has measured them.
desc.hi: कुछ छेद केवल लगभग एक फुट चौड़े हैं; उनकी गहराई मापी नहीं गई है।

desc.en: The deepest, most dangerous hole, often called the Devil's Kitchen. It's said to have claimed six lives by itself. On 3 September 2006, Subhash Chandran (19, from Manjummel, Ernakulam) fell in through a crevice. Reports describe the hole as about 100 ft (30 m) deep. The model shows about 30 m, the only reported figure.
desc.hi: 2006 के बचाव में इस्तेमाल हुए छेद को रिपोर्टों में लगभग 100 फुट (30 मीटर) बताया गया है। इससे अधिक गहराई के दावे सत्यापित नहीं हैं।

desc.en: When firemen were afraid to go down, Subhash's friend Siju David (Kuttan) climbed in with a 50-ft rope and another tied around his waist. About 60 ft (18 m) down he found Subhash lying on a rock, alive, and the firemen pulled them both up. Siju was later honoured with a Presidential award for bravery. It is still the only rescue of a living person from the caves. The ledge position in the model is approximate.
desc.hi: 2006 में सिजू डेविड रस्सी के सहारे लगभग 60 फुट नीचे गए और अपने मित्र सुभाष चंद्रन को जीवित पाया। बचाव-स्थल की जगह मॉडल में अनुमानित है।

desc.en: Bat colonies roost in the warm cracks of the caves. Tamil Nadu Tourism says that's where the name Devil's Kitchen comes from. During the 2006 rescue, Siju switched his torch on and saw only bats. The crevice here is illustrative.
desc.hi: गर्म दरारों में चमगादड़ों की बस्तियाँ रहती हैं। पुलिस रिकॉर्ड में 2016 तक कम-से-कम 16 लोगों के लापता होने या मृत्यु का उल्लेख है; गुफाओं की वास्तविक गहराई अज्ञात है।

desc.en: Nobody knows how deep the caves go. Police recorded at least 16 people who disappeared or died here by 2016, and only one body (Shenbaga Nadar, 1955) has been brought out. Popular stories claim drops of hundreds or even thousands of feet, but none have been measured. The model stops at about 30 m.
desc.hi: गुफाओं की कुल गहराई किसी ने नहीं मापी है। पुलिस ने 2016 तक कम-से-कम 16 लोगों के लापता होने या मृत्यु के मामले दर्ज किए; मॉडल लगभग 30 मीटर पर रुकता है और इसे वास्तविक नक्शा न मानें।

note.en: Self-built reconstruction from photos and published descriptions. The caves have never been surveyed, so the layout, depths and spot positions are approximate and for illustration only.
